exact_duplicate_excluded: ssd (100).jpg already present as public-ssd-100.jpg in existing training group mendeley-raw-source
split: train only; conservative single source group
annotation_method: Foreground contrast proposed tight boxes, then all 28 proposed boxes and all 12 negatives visually inspected at enlarged scale by Codex. Approximate, not independent annotations. No full-frame placeholder boxes.
storage_scope: storage_drive includes both SSD and HDD. At least some source SSD-folder photos depict a WD mechanical drive; folder name was not accepted as SSD subtype ground truth.
augmentation: Raw Data only; no supplied Augmented Data used. Derived crops remain in the same source group.
limitations: Isolated product photos, small components, controlled background; does not establish identification in working laptops. No test data added or modified.
